SessionStart._comment: The whole of this plugin: at the start of each chat (and after /clear) it decides from the person's mode file whether the chat has zero-touch, marks the chat, and shows the person one message saying so (again after a compaction or a reopened chat). The mmo plugin, which holds all of zero-touch's code, hooks and tools, acts only in a chat so marked (plugin/scripts/ambient/lib/chat-mode.mjs). Always exits 0.
